2:137.text: So if they believe in the same as you believe in, then they have been
guided; but if they turn away, they are only in dissension, and Allāh will be sufficient for you against them. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

2:139.text: , "Do you argue with us about Allāh while He is our Lord and your Lord? For us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds. And we are sincere

2:140.text: Or do you say that Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the Descendants were Jews or Christians? Say, "Are you more knowing or is Allāh?" And who is more unjust than one who conceals a testimony
he has from Allāh? And Allāh is not unaware of what you do.

2:141.text: That is a nation which has passed on. It will have
what it earned, and you will have what you have earned. And you will not be asked about what they used to do.
